original_requirement: Exempt only exact Latin terms approved by the current hash-bound Draft authority while preserving every genuine mixed-script corruption rejection and every downstream policy.
operational_definition: For the current Draft segment, a legacy MIXED_SCRIPT candidate is exempt only when its NFKC case-sensitive exact token has current PlanningSegmentIR or ShortExecutionManifest field provenance, exact source hashes, exact Draft authority revision/hash, and exact segment ownership binding; every unknown, stale, extended, ambiguous, or unrelated token remains blocking.
forbidden_narrowing: Do not disable MIXED_SCRIPT or permit Latin tokens by capitalization, length, acronym shape, project history, or model output.
Do not scan Prompt, Draft, Memory, FTS, references, Candidates, summaries, or arbitrary project files to create approvals.
Do not change Prompt, provider/model route, output budget, retry/fallback counts, semantic review, ownership, Manifest coverage, or non-MIXED_SCRIPT validators.
Do not persist raw terms, prose, prompts, tool arguments, credentials, or headers in diagnostics or reports.
closed_world_justification: The finite source contract is the already parsed current PlanningSegmentIR plus the exact matching ShortExecutionManifest segment and owned beats. The candidate set remains the pre-existing MIXED_SCRIPT regex. No inference outside those named objects is permitted.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Exact current authority provenance and fail-closed behavior
constraint_traceability.implementation: AuthorityApprovedLatinTermSetV1 and WorkflowService._draft_prose_authority_context bind source artifact hashes, field-path hashes, authority revision/hash, and segment binding.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Wrong segment, stale authority, missing provenance, unknown normalization, and excluded source_evidence all remain blocking.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Remove only the historical authority false positive
constraint_traceability.implementation: The private replay harness applies unchanged calls 20-22 to the current analyzer and leaf gate without printing source text.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Calls 20/21 retain 6/7 true-positive blockers; call 22 changes from one authority-term blocker to zero and crosses the prose boundary.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Prompt, route, budget, retry, semantic review, and business artifacts remain unchanged
constraint_traceability.implementation: Authority context is passed only to deterministic local validation and a best-effort hash-only receipt; model dispatch inputs are not modified.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Context on/off produces byte-identical system/user prompts, role sequence, max-output budgets, and two model boundaries under a fake gateway; live artifact snapshot is exact.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Other validators and authoritative boundaries remain monotonic
constraint_traceability.implementation: Only mixed_script_corruption is conditionally suppressed; all other findings, Manifest, ownership, semantic receipt, and checkpoint code remain authoritative.
constraint_traceability.evidence: 155 related tests pass with one pre-existing strict xfail; production-length 13K/20K/30K Short matrix passes.

projected_failure_mechanisms: approved term extended by an unapproved prefix or suffix
authority or source artifact advances after term projection
term belongs to another segment or ownership unit
normalization or Unicode connector is ambiguous
diagnostic sink fails after a valid business decision
Draft split or cached revalidation loses the authority context
model_output_variants_tested: CJK on both sides of an exact authority token
repeated and multiple approved tokens with duplicate provenance
invalid_output_variants_tested: unapproved Latin token adjacent to CJK
approved AI extended to AIX, AIabc, or XAI
approved GPT-5 extended with an extra suffix
stale authority and missing source provenance
unknown normalization and ambiguous Unicode connector
random repeated Latin corruption plus mojibake and control characters
transport_capacity_variants_tested: complete output-limit receipt accepted by independent completeness validation
truncated output-limit receipt rejected without commit
model_output_topology_classes_tested: compound technical token with joiners and version digits
unseen_valid_variants_tested: sanitized Node7 alphanumeric term not present in production evidence
sanitized API-v2.1 compound version term not present in production evidence
unknown_variant_behavior: Unknown token grammar, normalization version, provenance, authority, source hash, or segment binding fails closed to the original mixed_script_corruption finding; no retry or fallback is added.
why_previous_tests_missed: The old validator accepted only surface adjacency and had no current Draft authority input. Sanitized corruption tests therefore could not distinguish a legitimate exact term from damaged mixed-script text.

sibling_boundaries.boundary: fresh Draft local prose validation and completion check
sibling_boundaries.evidence: The context is used in completion_check, post-stage validation, and the leaf retry decision.

sibling_boundaries.boundary: cached Draft prefix and final segment integrity revalidation
sibling_boundaries.evidence: Each cached/generated part retains its parallel segment authority context and is rechecked with the same binding.

sibling_boundaries.boundary: Draft internal split children and recombined segment
sibling_boundaries.evidence: The unchanged parent segment context is threaded through both children and the final combined validation.
The default report shape and exact legacy MIXED_SCRIPT candidate set are preserved; absent context cannot exempt.

sibling_boundaries.boundary: Long workflow, Planning, Review, Polish, Final Review, and Maintenance
sibling_boundaries.evidence: No call site, Prompt, policy, or source module for these boundaries changed.

remaining_risks: No new real Provider Canary was authorized or run in R1-D1; readiness is based on exact replay and deterministic production-shaped workflows.
Calls 20 and 21 intentionally remain rejected for unapproved mixed-script tokens; only call 22 proves the historical authority false-positive closure.
Structured natural-language authority fields can contain incidental Latin words, but approval remains exact, current, source-hash-bound, and segment-local.
